work_identified: 'legs bshad snang ba dam pa' — a concise commentary on the Tibetan grammar root texts Sum cu pa and Rtags kyi 'jug pa (attributed to Thonmi Sambhota), held by the Ogyen Choling Collection, Bhutan (EAP105 endangered-archives project). Distinct from: (a) the root texts themselves; (b) Situ Chojung's extensive commentary 'mkhas pa'i mgul rgyan mu tig phreng mdzes'; (c) Dharmabhadra's 'Si tu zhal lung' (1806); (d) the similar-titled but distinct 2002 Varanasi publication by Karma smon lam 'od zer.

EAP105 = British Library Endangered Archives project digitising Ogyen Choling (Bhutan) manuscripts — confirms our book's provenance from this private Bhutanese collection
